2400fba6-6bb8-5352-b7eb-e0a1287312e4.name: Aetherial Lore
2400fba6-6bb8-5352-b7eb-e0a1287312e4.description: "Foolishly and greedily did the arcanists of Cairn delve into the magical veil known as the Aether, never once suspecting that something was looking back. The Aetherials descended upon Cairn in what is now known as the Grim Dawn, possessing countless humans and butchering the rest. Most despicably of all, they began raising the fallen as mutated undead creatures, mindless foot soldiers for their invasion. Their very presence on Cairn is enough to mutate the wildlife, turning once docile creatures into vicious monstrosities. But most strange of all is their apparent hatred for Chthonians, as they will battle against the horrors from the Void at every opportunity." You gain a deep insight into Aetherial lore, the ability to actually call upon these powers to produce various effects, and even thin out boundaries to cause a version of 'Grim Dawn' in your current reality (not sure why you would do that). The infohazardous knowledge granted by this perk is hidden from you; if it would harm you, you won't perceive it. Be wary - dabbling in such powers too much might attract the attention of something bigger on the other side, even if you intended otherwise, simply because you were not careful.

9d4b8989-ab1d-5663-9b4d-d84d9c61b455.description: To Arcanists, the manifestation of magic is not some unexplainable mystery or the will of the gods, but a science meant to be unraveled. This pursuit of knowledge drives all Arcanists, always eager to discover a new technique to make their namesake. Arcanists warp the mysterious aether and elements to their will, creating devastating demonstrations of power that rival small armies. However, such raw force leaves little in terms of defense. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Arcanist Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

a7e2d53e-c914-5611-b297-4932dcdaf572.name: Augment Making Recipes
a7e2d53e-c914-5611-b297-4932dcdaf572.description: "Augments are enchanted powders, tinctures and poisons that can be used to empower weapons, rings, and amulets. An item may have only one augment on it at any given time, and applying a new augment overwrites the old one. Salvaging or dismantling an augmented item does not return the augment." You gain ability to craft all augments from the game, apply them effectively. You can even tweak recipes slightly or use auguments in creative ways. However, you only have high skills, deep insight, and mystical powers when creating something from these recipes. Although, over time, some mundane or even more supernatural pieces of skills and knowledge might stick to you through the practice of crafting these items.

de0821f5-de64-5f01-b95a-e96c9945eabb.name: Chthonian Lore
de0821f5-de64-5f01-b95a-e96c9945eabb.description: "Chthonians, horrors from the Void, are the things of nightmares. Prior to the Grim Dawn, Chthonians would only be seen upon Cairn following an arcane ritual gone wrong or at the beckoning of a powerful sorcerer. Despite an effort to exterminate the practice, a cult has formed around blood rituals and the worship of Chthonic beings. Members of the cult have been overheard chanting one name in particular: Ch'thon. With the world in disarray, the cult has grown strong, garnering new followers desperate for answers in a world that no longer makes sense. Chthonians, and their loyal cult, appear to be at odds with the Aetherials, eagerly harvesting helpless humans for blood so that the Aetherials cannot use them as vessels." You gain a deep insight into Chthonian lore, the ability to actually call upon these powers to produce various effects, and even thin out boundaries so that things from the Void can slip into your current reality (not sure why you would do that). 851598d3-d856-5e0e-bbce-ba81ee57d58a.name: Complete Modifier
851598d3-d856-5e0e-bbce-ba81ee57d58a.description: You can apply modifiers inspired by Path of Exile mechanics to your own creations. Any item you are personally in the process of making (be it a device, weapon, armor, landmark, creature, or similar) is a valid target for modification. This process works best on things analogous to entities that could be modified in the original game. The cost in time and resources scales proportionally with the power of the modifiers and the nature of the target creation. Some modifiers are easier to apply to certain things, some modifiers work better and in more predictable way when applied to certain things.

19e013b5-9d68-51e8-9581-1e053ae43c4e.description: Pyrotechnic masters of the imperial army, Demolitionists are part engineer, part sorcerer. They were used to break enemy ranks and breach fortifications with their devastating array of explosives and destructive magic. They usually prefer to fight at range, engaging enemies with guns, traps and explosives but they can also be proficient with melee weapons. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Demolitionist Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

You don't have to spend the obtained devotion points - they can be stored indefinitely and used whenever you feel like it. After buying all the stars from all the constellations, you gain the ability to give these points to other people after each purchase of the perk.

59b62e98-0ed2-5d05-9105-b7d4dc67944d.description: Trained by the secretive Luminari Order, inquisitors were officially sanctioned by the Erulan Emperor to hunt down and eliminate all eldritch and arcane threats to the empire. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Inquisitor Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

Nightblades excel with all manner of martial weapons, but are even more feared for the deadly blade magic that is the secret of their trade. 0e88fff8-f190-55a8-9381-4f667c865f47.description: Driven by divine purpose and celestial fire in their hearts, Oathkeepers are a terror to the enemies of humanity. Their wills unbending, their faith their shield. None can withstand the righteous fury of a fully trained Oathkeeper. Oathkeepers may be servants of divine forces, but such forces may not always hold humanity in high regard or be sanctioned by the fallen Erulan Empire. Some Oathkeepers serve dark and corrupted powers, others see salvation in the light of Empyrion; others still believe that the Witch Gods are the only true gods and through their blessing they become a force of change upon Cairn. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Oathkeeper Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

Shamans excel in the use of brutal two-handed melee weapons, but can easily adapt to other tools of war when conjuring their primal powers. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Shaman Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

e7dd17b1-1a7f-5378-85cf-04648eac623d.description: Soldiers of the imperial army were trained to survive in the most hellish conditions and hold the line against the nastiest enemies of the empire. Soldiers prefer the use of close combat weaponry, such as a sword and shield, but can also prove formidable with firearms. What a Soldier may lack in outright damage output is made up for in fortitude and leadership. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Soldier Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

5f2329ca-ba77-5a5c-9da5-ae8bf6248eae.name: Aspects and Essences
5f2329ca-ba77-5a5c-9da5-ae8bf6248eae.description: This Tinker ability is all about working with the Essence and Aspects of physical objects and energy. You can build tools to decipher what conceptual components the targeted phenomenon contains, then create a device or method to extract a few highly expressed aspects from the object in the form of essences, and eventually figure out how to apply this essence to other objects. It is very research-intensive and requires one to focus on specific objects, aspects, and use cases each time. However, it allows you to create objects with bizarre properties using relatively mundane items as a source of essence. You can detect, isolate, extract, and eventually apply something like the 'toxicity' aspect from radiation to another device or material. Your usual tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

2dbd1d28-a62d-5f5d-8bd5-c9cd90137e48.name: Blackbox Principles
2dbd1d28-a62d-5f5d-8bd5-c9cd90137e48.description: You can apply principles of tinkertech blackboxing to mundane devices and your other creations. You have full control over the degree of blackboxing used and its nature. It can involve simple methods to make your creations resistant to reverse engineering and research by others, or a complete tinkertech-tier blackbox, making the inner workings of the machine practically incomprehensible and impossible for outside observers. However, you need to have some sort of target to apply this tinker power. It can work with a broad variety of creations, but a heavily blackboxed device might affect long-term performance and the ability of others to maintain it in a detrimental way. Different types of targets might also introduce some side-effects to the process. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

9cbdc283-2435-5e27-853f-aea7174d3d57.description: You are a tinker specializing in the creation of Bottled Superpowers. You can create various serums, elixirs, mutagens, and fantastic concoctions to grant supernatural, scientific, eldritch, or any other type of superpower to other people. They can have vastly different sources, methods of operation, and ways of integration. However, all Bottled Superpowers are somewhat random; it's hard to create powerful ones, and some methodologies might cause usual tinker problems in the created powers (such as the need for special maintenance, instability over time, etc.). Your tinker restrictions are partly lifted, depending on the kind of Bottled Superpowers you are making and how or to whom you want to apply them. Advice: don't mix too many powers in one subject; use extensive human trials to get rid of some problematic kinks of your product.

54b3d8d6-6220-5ff5-bc43-45cf9cc0c09d.description: You can build things out of carbon extremely well. This is your main material. For instance, you can figure out a way to create a fully functional smartphone, which is made of 98% carbon. Carbon metamaterials, nanostructures, and other exotic applications of the element are your bread and butter. However, you are still limited by what is hypothetically possible, and you need to find inspiration for devices in the outside world and the technology around you. This is a methodology type of tinker power. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

d96143d3-73bd-58c2-81ad-2e606c9581be.description: This tinker power specializes in clockwork and focuses on designing, building, and manipulating intricate mechanical devices and automata. This expertise allows you to create advanced clockwork machines, precision gears, and complex gear-driven systems. You can craft autonomous clockwork robots, intricate locks and traps, or elaborate timekeeping devices. This focus is really great at working with mechanical energy and its transformations. Methodology and possible devices to create are limited by clockwork theme. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

3dfb32ee-2653-5d1e-8d9a-157bf269cfe8.description: You are a tinker focused on the creation of 'mundane' devices, such as microwaves, freezers, toasters, and similar items. The things you make have the same functionality as their usual non-tinkertech variants, but extended, more efficient and more powerful. You can also attach some exaggerated upgrades to these basic functions if they are thematic - for example, a freezer that can keep perishable items in stasis, or a vacuum capable of absurd levels of suction. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

2dda8938-784b-5455-8091-dafced0e7b53.description: You are a Tinker focused on countering the works of other Tinkers. You excel at in-depth analysis of the functions and workings of other Tinker-made devices, along with creating the necessary tools to do so. However, your main focus is on creating devices to counter other Tinkertech. You can also create counters to your own creations, but doing so has 'inbreeding' effects - making the counters worse and more dangerous with each generation if you use your own work as inspiration. Unfortunately, you need to observe and research the works of other Tinkers to create anything, though you can still produce most basic tools and sensors within your specialization. Fortunately, you are still free to use counter-devices in any way you want; even if using them for purposes to different than their primary function is less efficient and, in some cases, can complicate maintenance. You can use this power to counter mundane tech, but its effectiveness is inversely proportional to your understanding of the targeted technology, and it generally works less well on non-Tinkertech. Your usual Tinker limitations are slightly lifted. Advice: target eldritch and alien technology.

The development of new devices and techniques is guided by principles of sustainability and ecological balance. Your methodology and creations are limited by the optimistic and environmentally conscious spirit of the solarpunk theme. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

52313f21-d353-5bc5-84f3-9a943c3c34dc.description: As Tinker specialized in Bulbs and Light Sources, you can create exotic illumination devices that produce mesmerizing and unusual effects, such as cooling, color-shifting, X-ray vision, projecting illusions, literal black light, etc. Think of Bakuda, but with bulbs, less destructive and energy intensive effects. 166c1dfa-de44-5d5f-9e99-48fc768f5189.name: Daily Hyperfixation
166c1dfa-de44-5d5f-9e99-48fc768f5189.description: For 24 hours, you gain a random tinkertech blueprint to work on. After 24 hours pass, the new blueprint you can build appears, and the old one disappears. You need to finish your current fixation project to save the blueprint and be able to build it again. If you cannot finish your current blueprint, all completed parts will be converted into inspiration to modify your previously saved blueprints, thematically related to the unfinished creation. You can finish a blueprint by cutting corners, but the saved blueprint will always be of a device you actually completed at the end of the current 24-hour cycle. So if you build crappy version - you get crappy blueprint. Your state of mind, levels of stress and living situation slightly affect what kind of blueprints you gain. Usually you gain blueprints, which are technically possible for your to finish in 24 hours, but not always. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

But a machine gun with homing rocket bullets? That is possible! Think of Bakuda, but with bullets and guns instead of bombs. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

However, they all use pneumatics to shoot the darts. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

Having familiarity with this community can greatly help you work with this tinker focus.

7c23565d-c053-5562-93e0-c6e3acd8923c.description: You can create specialized machines and devices for the refinement of materials and the creation of simple components. They are easy to automate but are very focused on a single task or narrow application. For example, a small furnace that is extremely good at refining copper from scraps and ore, turning it into high-purity ingots, but it doesn't work on any other metal. You need different machine for doing something else. They are also designed to be low-scale, producing small batches of product. You don't really scale up. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

71e9cb17-68a2-5b9e-befa-560b3ca838c6.description: You are a Tinker specializing in Mirrors and Reflection. You can create devices to reflect and mirror various effects. You have all the usual limitations of a Tinker.

9bfd7de0-c916-536d-8b55-aa5b0453e3dc.description: Your tinker ability is all about producing and folding paper to achieve your goals. It contains three narrow subcategories of things you are good at: Origami, Papermaking, and Scribbling. Origami is all about folding paper into efficient, useful shapes, and it can be used on other materials as well, but it becomes less effective the further the targeted matter is from the type of paper. Papermaking is focused on creating specialized papers for your work: bulletproof paper, hydrophobic paper, fire-resistant paper, etc. Scribbling is a more exotic craft involving inscribing patterns and text on paper to infuse it with unique added properties or to program it to do something (like folding in a specific way with a trigger condition attached). You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

59ccefbf-6ec5-5e93-802c-7533dc5bd7cd.name: Perpetual Motion
59ccefbf-6ec5-5e93-802c-7533dc5bd7cd.description: You are a tinker capable of creating various perpetual motion machines. Starting from basic classic designs that actually work to produce mechanical energy, and finishing with more esoteric and fundamental approaches made functional. Although, it is generally easier for you to create machines that can generate a relatively small amount of mechanical energy for an unlimited amount of time (not counting maintenance and other tinkertech-related problems). However, if you have a device on hand, it would be easy to adapt your design to power this specific machine. You have a relatively high upper scaling limit. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

969e9578-0b62-53b7-840e-3d012e160798.description: This unique tinker focus lets you create 'projections' of existing objects via usage of special custom devices. They function like copies of the original device or item, possessing most of its properties and functions (while not being truly material or permanent). For example, you can create a device to project several copies of a lightsaber to use, while keeping the original one safe. Or use something like an addon for the gun to essentially have infinite bullets, using projected matter to refill the gun. However, all projections created this way are connected to the original and cannot exist without it. At higher levels, you might store 'memory' of the original to partially sidestep this issue, but ultimately, any projection will wear out, warp in shape and function, and eventually collapse without an intact and accessible original to pull from. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

These devices are perfectly functional for what you create them for, but they are rather weird and make even less sense than usual Tinketech. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

67b1decd-e375-5c2e-925c-6629a1897914.description: You are a tinker able to create devices that reproduce and simulate various 'psychic' effects. Drawing inspiration from fiction, as well as actual supernatural and magical effects, will help you a lot. However, there is always some tradeoff in using these devices - some kind of mental cost. You can create a small device to achieve telekinetic flight, but at the cost of 4% of your maximum focus while the device is equipped. Or maybe you want to set things on fire with your gaze, but at the cost of permanently burning your own memories in quantities proportional to the complexity and power of the spontaneous combustion you are trying to achieve. Or you might literally spend your 'social battery' to fuel people-targeting psychometry. There is always a tradeoff - always a cost. At least, these devices are much less dangerous when used by you. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

38faf551-d4d9-5b6e-a6d1-3e4e6bc87443.description: On normal days, your tinker power is very good at making simple and robust (by tinkertech standards) tools and stockpiling special materials. But you accumulate charge in this state (which has an upper limit), which you can spend to enter a special kind of fugue. In this state, you turn temporarily schizophrenic and experience heavy hallucinations. What you experience in this state determines what you will build using the materials and tools around you. This fugue is extremely efficient at making you build things, even from subpar materials. It can last up to 48 hours (maximum charge) or until you lose consciousness due to stress and fatigue. In the end, you have some useful and bizarre tinkertech device (or several) with a general idea of what it does, but you need to actually research and test it to figure out the details of maintenance and any special quirks of the created item. The state of your psyche greatly affects the products. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

a2b94de6-9547-50e2-94aa-09c6303d0f9c.description: Your tinker focus is all about spiders and their derivative products. The first is about affecting the actual category of creatures labeled as 'spiders': modifying them, breeding and creating new ones, controlling them, and using them as helpers with tinkertech. The second is all about derivatives: production of various silks, custom toxins, and other spider-related physical materials. The third involves applying the properties of spiders to other things: building primitive spider-bots, creating serums to grant discount Spider-Man powers, etc. This specialty heavily relies on your conceptualization, creativity and knowledge of the theme. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

ed40aef7-e651-594c-a876-c7a2a9f3d2e7.description: You are a tinker specialized in the creation of attachments for other devices. 7e852c01-8774-5a1b-ae27-902155341523.name: The Art of Retrofitting
7e852c01-8774-5a1b-ae27-902155341523.description: Your tinker ability is uniquely centered around the concept of retrofitting - transforming and upgrading existing devices, structures, and systems into new, more advanced forms. You excel at taking old, outdated, or broken technology and infusing it with innovative modifications, turning it into something far more capable than its original design. Whether it's retrofitting a simple machine to handle complex tasks, upgrading a worn-out device with cutting-edge components, or repurposing old technology for modern use, you thrive on creatively reimagining the potential of what already exists. Your expertise lies in customizing and enhancing rather than inventing from scratch. However, your retrofitting process often results in devices that are unpredictable or temperamental - sometimes working flawlessly, other times malfunctioning in unexpected ways. This can lead to surprising outcomes. The more outdated and old the technology you are working with, the more efficient this ability is. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

85ddd6b3-d22e-59fe-b241-6ba6b4c0b198.description: Your tinker power is focused on the creation of cloned brains in boxes. You can create copies of brains (yours or other people's), download knowledge, personality, and data into them, then put these brains into jars and force them to think up ideas and solutions for you using various mastering techniques, brainwashing and various similar methods. Completely unethical, and you must ensure from time to time that these brains won't try to betray you by booby-trapping some of their ideas. However, it is really efficient for offloading solution searching and brute-forcing creativity. This specialty doesn't let you create anything else but think-tanks and will oppose you if you try to use it to create something else (like fully functional clones). Although, it includes methods of quickly and efficiently coping results from think-tanks and implanting these ideas into your head. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

3c0abc01-cf86-5554-a6a5-239becc2dcad.name: Tinker of Escalation
3c0abc01-cf86-5554-a6a5-239becc2dcad.description: Your tinker power revolves around the concept of Escalation. It allows you to push existing devices and systems beyond their original limits, increasing their power, complexity, and unpredictability. While you can turn simple gadgets into formidable or unstoppable creations, your escalations often cause unpredictable ripple effects in the environment, making your inventions prone to instability or chaos (you are less affected personally). The more pressure is applied from outside, the faster and more effectively your Escalation potential grows and quicker it can be turned into upgrades. However, if you suddenly stop escalating the acceleration 'counter' resets, and all devices built by you begin to malfunction more often, requiring more maintenance and quickly losing their power, potential and danger. This is a methodology-type of tinker power - you need outside inspiration or devices to use as a starting point for the process. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

More importantly, you possess a natural talent for researching alien hostile life and developing effective countermeasures (whether chemical, biological, or mechanical) against such evolutionary threats.

9028473b-b082-5b2e-8385-a73a2a67c033.name: Infinite Source
9028473b-b082-5b2e-8385-a73a2a67c033.description: Once purchased, this perk allows you to select one existing resource deposit within your immediate vicinity and apply a replenishing quality to it. The chosen source will become endlessly renewable: gradually restoring itself over time as long as you do not mine it too aggressively. The speed of replenishment depends on the nature of the material. Common resources like coal regenerate quickly, while rarer or more complex substances like redstone restore at a much slower rate. Additionally, the farther a resource deviates from Factorio-style materials in nature and complexity, the less effective this replenishing effect becomes. There is an upper limit to both the size and complexity of deposits that can be targeted: massive or exceptionally intricate formations may be beyond this perk's ability to affect. The effect is not disruptive to things around the deposit and machines mining it. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional purchase (discounted to 400 CP) stacking another activation in storage. You may hold these effects indefinitely, waiting until you find a suitable target before spending them.

However, this technology functions strangely. If you do not have access to the original Factorio Spidertron as a foundational technology, these advanced variants will be forced into a tinkertech paradigm - reliable in your hands but poorly understood, difficult to maintain, and impossible for others to replicate without your direct involvement. Based on Spidertron Extended mod for Factorio.

7a0f069a-fb38-541a-9e50-1b720908b51f.name: White Science
7a0f069a-fb38-541a-9e50-1b720908b51f.description: You gain the foundational knowledge required to begin your journey into Factorio-style space technology. This perk provides you with basic understanding of rocket construction, satellite payloads, and the principles needed to reach beyond your home world. True mastery requires exploration. By building space-bound devices, launching rockets, and proactively traveling through space using knowledge from this perk, you will rapidly expand your capabilities. Actual space exploration and travel provide the best returns: each new frontier teaching you how to improve your space-faring technology until you have mastered the full breadth of Factorio's celestial ambitions.

1e84d94a-7cf3-5a28-a6f1-24ace619b9e4.name: Administrator Engine
1e84d94a-7cf3-5a28-a6f1-24ace619b9e4.description: This metaperk automatically connects to all other perks and powers you have and updates when you acquire new ones. Its primary goal is the management and control of the various effects that powers give you. It grants you the ability to tune and even turn powers on or off, even for ones which usually don't have any means of control. You can preprogram various quick changes to tweak the operation of many abilities at once, giving you more precise control over the abilities you possess and making it easier to monitor what they do and when. Of course, it works a bit differently with different perks and tries to adapt to them. Basically, it just gives a control panel to better monitor and manage your powers.

71d90437-7bd6-518c-96f5-3b697c2f2647.name: Aspect Loom
71d90437-7bd6-518c-96f5-3b697c2f2647.description: You can unravel matter and energy into thick, colorful threads and wind them into balls that represent aspects of an object. Simply touching your target starts the process. These threads can be stored in a special pocket dimension and accessed at any time. If you haven't altered the threads, you can turn them back into the original objects. The mass, volume, and complexity of the target determine how many threads you obtain and how easy/hard it is to do, but it will always be lesser in mass and volume than the original unraveled object. You can split these threads into more, unraveling the nature of the object into simpler aspects. Using different threads, you can create patterns so that when they are reassembled, the resulting object will be different - made of aspects of your original target and inspired by the new shape. You are an expert in working with threads and possess an unnatural intuition for manipulating aspect threads specifically. Others can also work with these threads and even restore them into objects using the right supernatural energies or abilities, but without your unnatural intuition, it is difficult for them to find effective or useful patterns.

db80ff80-0d28-5a4e-ae96-b44f26739165.name: Dionysus Ultimate Blessing
db80ff80-0d28-5a4e-ae96-b44f26739165.description: You cannot die from overdrinking; at some point, it will stop worsening. Any damage caused by drinking will be healed by a short hangover afterward. You do not suffer from the usual side effects of alcoholism, such as developing a tolerance to alcohol. While you are at least a little bit drunk, you cannot be poisoned by other substances. Your luck slightly increases with how drunk you are at the moment, though there is a limit. You are extremely knowledgeable about cocktails, alcoholic beverages, and how to drink them correctly. You can consume methanol or similar "alcoholic" substances without dying, going blind, or experiencing other severe consequences, but the hangover will be longer and much worse. You can still get drunk, even if other powers prohibit or make it impossible. You can experience degrees of drunkenness beyond what an unmodified human brain can normally comprehend. If you want to get intoxicated from drinking at the moment - you will!

005a3803-1e7e-5d4b-a532-c913261fbaa9.name: Escalating Harm
005a3803-1e7e-5d4b-a532-c913261fbaa9.description: Once you land an initial strike on an opponent, your subsequent attacks against the same target grow increasingly devastating. Each successive blow deals twice the damage of the previous one. For example, if your first hit causes a minor abrasion, the second strike will be twice as severe, and the third strike will be four times as severe as the first. This escalation resets if you switch targets and rapidly decays, if you pause between attacks for too long. The ability only functions if your first attack deals meaningful damage. It doesn't work if your first attack didn't deal enough damage and can the effect can be interrupted by other exotic effects.

4edf0aa0-76e8-585f-8f87-2c57d8bc357a.name: Fire Fiends Creation
4edf0aa0-76e8-585f-8f87-2c57d8bc357a.description: You can create free fire spirits or infuse items with them using living things you have burned down yourself as the source - either from their ashes or by literally dragging specks of "inner fire" from the corpses of your foes. These "fiends" need to eat fire or highly flammable materials to survive, but even then, they have limited and usually short lifespans because they age relatively quickly. They are generally aligned with you, listen to your orders, and are loyal, but tend to be mischievous and "fiery" in character due to their nature. They live longer when infused into objects, but their effects are less powerful in that form. Depending on exotic and unqiue properties of things you burnt to create them, friends might possess some traces of traits and characteristics of the burnt object.

32b2a243-71bb-5f99-99d4-912199260bdd.name: Fluid Light
32b2a243-71bb-5f99-99d4-912199260bdd.description: You are capable of absorbing light with the surface of your body, turning it into a transparent fluid and excreting it from any point on your body. Disturbing this substance causes it to partly revert back into light (for example, by suddenly heating it or punching it hard). This liquid is practically weightless and has very low viscosity. However, you can concentrate more light into the same volume of liquid. Doing so will make it heavier and more viscous, the more light you pack into it. Additionally, disturbing it will produce brighter light with a shorter wavelength. You are good at absorbing visible light but terrible at absorbing non-visible light. There is a limit to how much you can absorb, store, and recycle per unit of time.

0c884908-7c58-55e6-a875-f4eb9ad59b1d.description: You can cause almost any physical object or part of it to pop, as if it were a balloon - simply by applying enough pressure or using something like a needle. Larger and more massive objects explode with greater power. After performing the 'pop' action, you have a short window of invulnerability to protect you from the explosion itself and some of the shards it produces, but nothing beyond that. You have perfect control over when this ability is active.

f608cc60-42a4-5201-b5ad-51cde7304c96.name: Just Pop It
f608cc60-42a4-5201-b5ad-51cde7304c96.description: You can cause almost any physical object or part of it to pop, as if it were a balloon - simply by applying enough pressure or using something like a needle. Larger and more massive objects explode with greater power. After performing the 'pop' action, you have a short window of invulnerability to protect you from the explosion itself and some of the shards it produces, but nothing beyond that. You have perfect control over when this ability is active.

3a4ae745-e675-5b64-b6cc-cdb0443ab463.name: Metaphorical Flames
3a4ae745-e675-5b64-b6cc-cdb0443ab463.description: You can use metaphorical sources of flame inside and around you to fuel your magic. For example, you can draw upon your own flaming rage or fires of will to produce mystical effects. Doing so will make these inner fires burn brighter for a time, but they will also turn to cold ash more quickly. This means that if you use something like rage or willpower as fuel, they will temporarily intensify, only to burn out afterward - leaving behind disinterest, apathy, or similar emotional numbness. You will need to restore them before they can be used again. As such, it is often wiser to use something like the potential flames trapped inside gunpowder on your person as fuel, even if such sources may be less effective or nearly impossible to utilize for certain tasks. Sourcing metaphorical flames requires creativity and careful thought. Some sources are easier or better suited for particular magical tasks than others, and the type of flame you use may influence the resulting magic. For instance, you cannot directly use the flames of another person's rage, but if you bait them into focusing their anger on you, it becomes easier to draw upon. Similarly, using flames of rage is well-suited for violent tasks, though the magic may take on side-effects associated with anger: effects that become much more pronounced if the task already aligns closely with the concept of rage. Not everything can serve as a source; it must be some form of metaphorical flame, or at the very least, fuel for one.

99d1dc54-f4d2-58b1-a306-20439bac7ff6.name: Mortis Essence Accumulation
99d1dc54-f4d2-58b1-a306-20439bac7ff6.description: You have a metaphorical vessel of 'mortis essence' inside your soul. You can replenish this magic by killing or witnessing death personally. You become stronger and can restore powers in places drenched in death or strongly associated with the dead, as recognized by the local population or creatures in the area. You gain more from killing or witnessing the death of someone who resists death or being killed. You also gain more from sleeping or meditating in places associated with the dead. Different creatures, types of death, and locations influence your replenishment. You cannot accumulate too much mortis essence, as it makes you more vulnerable to death: stopping bleeding takes longer, severe wounds are more likely to cause death, you get ill more easily, etc. So, you need to find a way to get rid of the excess or figure out how to block/control automatic replenishment of the essence before it kills you. Mortis essence is strongly aligned with arts related to death and the dead, such as necromancy or burial arts, but is not limited to them.

46ee2ff2-fe5f-5101-a95d-65c84b5c3f2e.name: Ocean of Bouillon
46ee2ff2-fe5f-5101-a95d-65c84b5c3f2e.description: You can instantly conjure great quantities of fresh, boiling-hot (or cold, depending on the dish), and delicious soup, broth or stew in any targeted empty vessel. It must be some kind of mundane soup, broth or stew, and you should be somewhat familiar with specific dish to actually summon it. The substance created this way is enhanced to be perpetually hot (or cold, depending on the dish) and fresh until eaten or ruined by external factors (like dirt getting into it). After that, these special properties gradually (or abruptly) diminish and disappear completely. You can instantly fill a cauldron with your favorite stew, definitely a tub, or even the whole room. It just needs to be some non-living vessel with physical access to its insides. There is a limit of how much you can create at once, but its a lot of stew/soup/broth.

52f30bf6-c4cd-53d7-9794-93181d8a2138.name: Oddly Convenient Spare Parts
52f30bf6-c4cd-53d7-9794-93181d8a2138.description: When breaking down or disassembling something, you can often find spare parts inside, even if there shouldn't be any. While you cannot precisely control which spare part you will get, you can steer it slightly in the desired direction. Repeatedly disassembling and reassembling objects allows you to dupe pieces with each iteration. Although, there are diminishing returns for doing it to the exact same thing over and over again. The terms 'disassembly' and 'something' are quite flexible - breaking rocks with a pickaxe or preparing wood also technically count as disassembling. As a result, you may find yourself with more spare parts or useful items than expected, even in these cases. Very rarely, when searching for space parts, you might discover unique, thematic items related to what you disassembled among spare parts - for example, finding a golden nugget in a piece of rock you broke down, even if it shouldn’t be there. You also have a knack for dismantling objects quickly, safely and carefully. Nothing supernatural though.

6453490d-8752-50f5-bbe6-6c24c985014d.name: Resources Conversion
6453490d-8752-50f5-bbe6-6c24c985014d.description: You have an inventory space size of one cubic meter. You can put resources, materials, and even some components into this extradimensional space with a touch, as long as they are not larger than a cube with a side of one meter. Things inside this space will be converted from one resource into another after specific time passes. How long this takes depends on three parameters: Properties, Composition, and Shape. How different these three between the original target and intended result. For example, you can put one type of steel into this space and turn it into another of your liking in a matter of minutes: one alloy of iron transformed into another. You are only aware of how long the transformation will take after putting something inside the space and choosing end state of conversion. You can eject items at any time (they will remain unchanged if not enough time has passed for full processing) and must do so if you want to change what is currently contained in this cubic dimension (you cannot add stuff, while something is inside). Trying to turn something into a completely different type of entity might take years and even decades to process, which is usually not worth it. Some small amount of material gets lost in the conversion process, proportionally to how much time it took to convert. End result depends on what you are asking this power to do, but cannot be anything but resource, material or component.

2a141b7c-d5bd-525e-a8ce-51dc41f4ed17.description: You possess the ability to project and throw small pellets that burst into a cloud of capsaicin-derived substance, similar to tear gas but potentially stronger. You have control over the volume of gas clouds each pellet produces when you create it and the potency of substance. You are immune to the effects of the tear gas in general, allowing you to navigate through the cloud unharmed. Pellets do not persist for long - they disappear after some time, if they lose contact with you and/or not being used/destroyed.

508ea44d-8406-541c-809a-b9e46c6d5cb8.name: Tearful Pellets

7130d708-8c46-5391-9ca4-9cbccb6adb7e.name: Transmutative Rise
7130d708-8c46-5391-9ca4-9cbccb6adb7e.description: You gain the ability to transmute matter through touch. Target a volume of up to one liter and one kilogram in weight that you can physically separate from its surroundings. After several minutes of focus, the targeted matter glows briefly and transmutes, increasing the atomic number of each element within by exactly one. The time required scales with the atomic number of the elements involved. Turning iron (26) into cobalt (27), for example, takes approximately twenty minutes of concentration. The transmutation produces stable isotopes whenever possible, though there may be logical, unexpected, or even dangerous consequences, albeit somewhat softened from what physics would normally dictate.

9f8fef0b-445f-556f-b1db-b634e3ca958e.name: Valaknots
9f8fef0b-445f-556f-b1db-b634e3ca958e.description: Valaknots are ancient symbols that warp body and mind when carved into flesh. Believed to be gifted to mortals by the god of change, Maudamouros, these symbols allow the manipulation of living creatures - including animals, plants, and fungi. Valaknots do not work on dead material; they require living entities. They can reshape bodies, empowering or diminishing them in countless ways, and can even grant some the power to conjure or manipulate different matter. Valaknots are arranged into patterns called Valachains. Mistakes in carving will lead to consequences. You have the expertise and carving skills of a decently experienced Valaknot practitioner, but without a specific focus or tradition. You possess your own rather humble mental library of randomly chosen Valaknots: you know what they do and how they mesh together into various Valachains. By spending additional 200 CP (or more), you can buy proficiency in one of the specific traditions of the art: The Flesh Forge, The Saltfen Brood, The Fellwood Druids. By personally instructing and guiding others, you might give them ability to use and teach others the art of Valaknots. (Author: Creature Guild)

7c573a75-26db-5fee-ad8b-afd489db6017.name: Wooden Stake
7c573a75-26db-5fee-ad8b-afd489db6017.description: You possess the ability to rapidly grow and produce dead wood from your own body. This wood can take on various shapes such as beams, stakes, thorns, curved branches, and other pointy objects. You have the flexibility to make them hollow or alter their inner structure or surface for a little while, even making them polished. Your power does not tarnish your clothes or other thin materials around you (if you don't want it to). The wood you create is dark, dense, and exceptionally hard. It is resistant to catching fire, but if it does ignite, it burns rapidly. It is very susceptible to natural decay and rots relatively quickly over time. You have the power to infuse existing or created wood (including alive) with your energy. For instance, you can charge a small piece of wood, throw it, and after a certain time, it will begin to transform into preprogrammed pointed shapes, resembling your own body’s abilities, until the charge is depleted. Alternatively, you can grow wood from other wooden surfaces that you come into contact with. Charged wood, under your control, can be easily broken by you and poses no harm to you.

4851b0bc-7155-5d8f-8708-2a66b3e43e13.description: "$$$" - This perk gives you 100 Pennies. In this case, Pennies are imaginary and immaterial unspecified currency, which you can materialize into actual money at any moment. It works only one way - Pennies into material currency, but be sure - now you have some sizable sum in your metaphorical (and soon literal) pocket!

98c83bed-9c0c-5d4b-8215-1dbd4cac624e.description: "Flight + Dash Attack." - This stick horse grants the ability to fly and passively increases your speed. When activated, you charge in the direction the pony is facing, gaining a degree of invulnerability during the dash and dealing damage to enemies in your path. The active ability has a cooldown. Upon equipping the item, you gain basic knowledge of its usage and functionality.

4b7d7497-bf4a-5c8e-b86e-62a4b826dded.description: This tome contains all three volumes of Alchemillia - a comprehensive guide for beginner, intermediate, and experienced alchemists. It allows you to learn and use alchemy skills from the Fear & Hunger games, even in worlds where such knowledge should not exist or function. Copies you make of the original book still work to grant skills, but their power diminishes in proportion to how little personal effort you invested in creating them. Copies made from other copies diminish further still.

c8c103b1-02c9-5776-9c2d-afc14fd2bbe0.description: "Summon bombs." - This is an actual Anarchist Cookbook and can be read like any normal text. It is more in-depth and factual than a standard copy, and provides a slight passive boost to learning and using the knowledge contained within. Its active effect spawns seven primed explosive devices of reasonable power at random points nearby, which detonate after a few seconds. The book has a cooldown and grants the wielder general knowledge of its effects and usage upon equipping it.

6eadff51-c9d4-51dc-9c1d-2c18a06cb22b.description: "Friends 'till the end." - This small doll, when activated, spawns a decoy that explodes after five seconds. Enemies are attracted to the decoy and lose track of the user. The effect has a cooldown. The decoy resembles a person lying on the ground, but can take on different appearances and illusory details to better draw enemies' attention.

08ae1ea2-678d-51de-b282-ee0c63d33740.description: "Mass Enemy Damage at a Cost." - You gain a straight razor artifact with special properties, along with basic knowledge of how to use it. When you cut yourself with this razor (an action that deals consistent damage but causes no bleeding) it inflicts burst of damage on everyone you perceive as an enemy in your immediate vicinity, primarily in the form of internal trauma and spontaneous cuts. Used on others, the razor is simply an exceptionally durable and always-sharp blade. The main effect has a cooldown, and the razor provides feedback to its current user about when it can be used again.

34774aae-083d-5e3b-8f32-5a39db5cbdce.description: You have the skill and knowledge to engrave sigils on yourself or willing party members. Each sigil's benefit varies depending on the god it represents. Historically, these markings were carved across the body, though modern practitioners prefer facial sigils for greater efficiency. You can consistently create and utilize these sigils from Fear & Hunger game, unlocking their effects.

406de8ec-0b8c-58d9-bf7a-b16bcf880efa.description: “May your rage bring haste.” - Each time you take damage in combat, your speed and agility receive a temporary boost. This effect can stack up to six stages, increasing with each hit. The boost decays rapidly once you are no longer fighting.

a7e08a3f-af7c-5a7a-9a52-f66bcb803407.name: Bloody Gust

2a7107bf-5bcc-59fb-8f64-f1bd2ab3f64d.description: "Reusable soul protection." - This item, upon use, grants one soul heart. Soul hearts work like a form of absorptive armor, taking damage instead of hurting your body. Depending on the severity, a different number of metaphorical hearts will be lost to absorb the damage. You can have a maximum of 12 soul hearts. There is a small chance of encountering the Harbinger boss attacking you shortly after using the book. The wielder of the book gains knowledge of how to use it and a general description of its effect. The active effect has a relatively long cooldown. You can also read it as a normal book.

For example, if you are wounded at the moment of activation, you will remain wounded after the reset. This perk may be purchased multiple times. Note that traveling back does not guarantee events will unfold the same way. The perk itself provides general knowledge of the pill's effect to you.

124b5cbb-850d-5be0-bf09-11a175f1a3cb.description: "Turn back time." - Upon active use, this item rewinds time to the last major branching point in your timeline - a moment where small choices can lead to significant changes. This typically sends you back a few minutes, but can sometimes rewind up to an hour or even a full day. Only your mind travels back; your body, items, and surroundings remain as they were. The hourglass holds three charges and can be used three times. Repeated use cannot take you further back than 24 hours from the moment of the previous activation, meaning you cannot rewind twice in quick succession to exceed that limit. The only way to recharge it is to purchase this perk again (at half price - 400 CP), though the hourglass can never store more than three charges. Upon equipping the item, you gain basic knowledge of its usage and functionality.

305ae9e7-f1be-55fe-a20f-17df1c44e145.description: You are something of an expert when it comes to dealing with hunger and fear. While you don't have actual experience, you possess many unique practical skills, useful trivia, and helpful habits to call upon when needed. This includes not only things like finding food or knowing how to cook and eat usually inedible items, but also strategies such as psyching yourself up to consume something gross or how to use drugs to relieve stress while minimizing the chances of psychological addiction. You know various techniques to cope with fear and stress, and have an aptitude for managing feelings of hunger and exhaustion.

9d122cc5-6d7c-547b-80cf-7e1efac90904.description: "Never ending stores!" - This is a metaperk that allows you to purchase subsequently rolled perks multiple times for one roll. Each additional copy costs 200 CP more than the last. Perks bought this way will stack or fuse to increase their quality or quantity. You may also choose to buy the perk repeatedly as separate "copies" to give away later. For example, if your next roll is a free perk, you could purchase it again for 200 CP, then again for 400 CP, and so on - either stacking the effects with what you already have or holding them to distribute later. Restock does not affect other metaperks, nor does it function if the rolled perk can already be purchased multiple times as part of its normal function.

3724fb30-a08a-589d-aabd-b8b7938a6915.description: You possess the ability, skills, and knowledge to create and use ritual circles from the Fear & Hunger games. Unlike the circles available in the games, yours offer expanded functionality and versatility. Be cautious - these circles connect to the divine entities from their source setting and draw upon their authorities, which may attract unwanted attention or introduce unsettling phenomena into your current reality. You are capable of teaching this art to others, allowing the practice to spread from person to person. All infohazardous knowledge is locked away from you, if it would harm you to know.

23c152ba-7c8e-590c-be78-14da2121016e.description: "It's only up from there." - This perk revents your physical attributes from falling below their highest values reached. Attributes continue to be calculated normally internally. Rather than use your current stats, items and effects will impact the same way they would as if you did not have Rock Bottom. Temporary buffs work normally, though they may make reaching new best values harder after the buff has worn off. Basically, stat penalties are accounted for, causing increased difficulty of reaching new best values.

Your expertise centers on the conversion of matter and energy into digital form for the purposes of storage, transportation, retrieval, and even automated processing - transforming physical resources into data and back again with remarkable efficiency. 01478788-8099-5a7d-a422-714dc6e71358.name: Better Dimensions
01478788-8099-5a7d-a422-714dc6e71358.description: You possess the ability to modify portals to the Nether and the End, allowing you to redirect them to their modded counterparts instead. By mixing and matching different combinations of mods - such as Better Nether or Better End - you can extensively customize each portal and the dimension it leads to. However, there are limitations. There is only one version of a dimension for each modified portal decided by the moment you firstly created specific variation of the gates: each version of the dimension can only be generated once. Modifying a portal requires both time and resources, and you must first possess the ability to build vanilla Minecraft portals for this perk to function properly. In addition, you gain extensive and in-depth knowledge of all things related to the mods you wish to use. You are intimately familiar with the materials, structures, creatures, flora, dangers, and useful tricks found within these transformed dimensions, ensuring you are prepared for what awaits.

4e6cbbf0-a10b-5baa-8bac-253898762910.description: There are many modpacks with some sort of quest system or book. You gain the ability to create personal, soul-bound quest books for individuals. Each person can possess only one such book, and it cannot be destroyed by conventional means, as it is a projection of their inner world. These books contain unique, dynamically updating quests tailored to the owner. Completing quests rewards the individual with thematic prizes based on their accomplishments. However, the nature of both quests and rewards depends heavily on the person: their desires, beliefs, knowledge, and personal journey.

243c1cec-cb73-5739-9b5f-fc48c39c8fe5.name: Builder's Might
243c1cec-cb73-5739-9b5f-fc48c39c8fe5.description: You have access to powers inspired by a player character from the Minecraft game. You abilities can summarized as: >Force - You belong to a race of Builders capable of channeling a unique Force to empower their actions and intended functions of thier tools. This energy makes tools more efficient, weapons more dangerous, and has many other applications - some obvious, others requiring discovery and practice to master. >Inventory - Builders possess a personal pocket dimension for storing items and materials. Storage capacity depends on volume, mass, and material diversity. Objects inside are frozen in time, but creatures with complex enough minds or strong willed can resist being stored quote easily. >Crafting - Builders can manipulate materials stored in their inventory, either subtly or by projecting their work externally - allowing collaboration and easier visualization. When combined with Force, they can even reshape items outside their inventory. By studying an object, they gain its blueprint, enabling them to replicate it if they have the necessary materials, skills, and tools. >Building - Builders can construct structures that defy conventional architecture, such as floating islands, by subtly altering the mass of matter in exotic way. These effects can be disrupted by sufficient force or degrade slowly over time due to wear and tear. >Peak Body - A Builder's Force constantly preserves their body, granting biological immortality, rapid healing, and even regeneration of lost limbs over time. Severe injuries may drain bodily resources, increasing hunger and thirst. They are also significantly tougher, stronger, and more resilient than an average human, with their body striving to return to its peak state when resources are available and being able to quickly replenish energy and materials via eating. >Awareness - Builders have heightened awareness of their own bodies, enhancing agility, dexterity, and speed, and allowing them to learn or relearn skills quickly. They instinctively know if they are ill or poisoned and, with enough experience, can identify the cause. >Respawn - By sleeping in a safe place with a calm mind and intent, you can set a spawn point. Upon death, you may respawn there once every 24 hours, though you temporarily weaken and lose all items. Respawn only works if the location remains intact, your soul is whole, and no heavy dimensional barriers interfere.

26379935-a692-500d-9dc6-49ca8cc0f970.description: You possess extraordinary dexterous and steady hands, and the ability to craft items on the fly without the use of specialized instruments or crafting stations. 55d63971-4ebf-5a4f-9de2-88b50f5e2f22.name: Calamity Expansion
55d63971-4ebf-5a4f-9de2-88b50f5e2f22.description: You gain the ability to craft all types of items from the Calamity mod and its various addons for Terraria (including unobtainable and hardmode-exclusive variants). Their special properties, including legendary effects, unique abilities, and devastating power, are preserved due to the supernatural component of this perk. You possess a complete mental compendium of every Calamity item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and god-slaying properties of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical essence from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

c0ee0909-4e48-51a9-8127-a59acd874da0.name: Calamity Expansion
c0ee0909-4e48-51a9-8127-a59acd874da0.description: You gain the ability to craft all types of items from the Calamity mod and its various addons for Terraria (including unobtainable and hardmode-exclusive variants). Their special properties, including legendary effects, unique abilities, and devastating power, are preserved due to the supernatural component of this perk. You possess a complete mental compendium of every Calamity item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and god-slaying properties of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical essence from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

5680efa5-6b87-562d-9130-444b76b0e19e.name: Charging Gadgets
5680efa5-6b87-562d-9130-444b76b0e19e.description: This perk grants you the ability to construct a single, deceptively simple machine - the charging station. Despite its unassuming design, this device functions as a full tinkertech apparatus capable of recharging almost any item from Minecraft mods, and with some creative tweaking, it can even be modified to charge other, unrelated devices you may encounter. You do not understand how it works on any fundamental level, and frankly, you are reasonably certain it should not work this well given how simple the design appears. Nevertheless, it provides an easy and reliable solution for keeping your various gadgets powered. Perhaps if you dedicated significant time to researching the device in depth, you might begin to figure out some of the little things that make it tick...

21350b70-ca97-5064-84be-ef18314746e0.description: Why build a warehouse when you can build a drawer? You now have the know-how and ability to construct containers that defy physics, from simple chests to elaborate drawer systems, all capable of holding stacks upon stacks of items. Some specialize in single item types for efficiency, while others accept everything (and will absolutely become a sorting nightmare if you're not careful). Your repertoire includes designs inspired by Storage Drawers, Sophisticated Backpacks, and Iron Chests, allowing you to experiment with a wide variety of functions. Do note that this technology is essentially tinkertech running at maximum settings - held together by fiat rather than genuine physics. With time and study, you may eventually learn to create truly "bigger on the inside" containers that function without reality-warping assistance, but not using this perk alone.

64626b12-e655-5ccd-9fa9-888cacb20237.description: You possess all blueprints, expertise, and practical skills required to build and operate devices inspired by the Create mod for Minecraft, along with several of its most famous addons. Your knowledge centers primarily on mechanical engineering, rotational power, factory automation, and the wonderfully complex "tinker-bullshit". Included addons cover a wide range of themes: Steam 'n' Rails for trains and locomotives; Crafts & Additions for supplementary tools; Big Cannons for artillery; New Age for alternative power sources; Enchantment Industry for automated enchanting; Utilities for miscellaneous gadgets; and others besides. However, exploring addons further removed from the core mechanical theme becomes progressively more difficult - the more distant an addon's focus from the main Create experience, the harder and more vaguely defined your knowledge becomes, requiring greater time and effort to master, making your creations less reliable.

9b0514d9-9582-50c4-bcaf-271fa1b02518.description: This perk allows you to generate the Infectious Desert biome from the Minecraft Desertification mod, transforming the area within a few kilometers around you into this hostile landscape. The biome will spread slowly outward from the initial point of impact after generation using sand, though the speed and effectiveness of this spread depend heavily on the nature of the surrounding environment (including native flora and fauna), the resistance of local materials, and geographical features that may hinder or accelerate the infection. You may hold this effect in storage indefinitely, waiting until you find a suitable location before unleashing it. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional purchase (discounted to 300 CP) stacking another held activation for later use. The first purchase of this perk also grants you encyclopedic knowledge about the nature, contents, and unique properties of the Infectious Desert biome, including any resources, creatures, or phenomena found within and how to take advantage of them.

However, when the situation demands it, sufficient abilities should be granted to them - but they must work to achieve those abilities, and you, the responsible owner, should help them." You have a natural affinity for bonding with and training canine companions, unlocking their hidden potential and teaching them a wide variety of useful talents and abilities. Your dogs will accompany you faithfully, growing stronger through shared effort.

The mod doesn't do much on its own and is intended to be configured heavily. All recipes and settings should be changed to fit the progression of the modpack it's in and how the modpack developer wants it to be used." This perk grants you great knowledge of extended crafting methodologies, along with a supernatural advantage when designing and applying modifications to any blueprint you already possess. It also provides the base blueprints needed to construct the fundamental machinery from the mod itself. Essentially, this perk allows you to fundamentally change how you craft things: discovering new approaches, combining existing knowledge in novel ways, and creating entirely new production methods using only the resources and recipes you already have at your disposal. You may hold this effect in storage indefinitely, waiting until you find a suitable location before unleashing it. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional purchase (discounted to 300 CP) stacking another held activation for later use. The first purchase of this perk grants you complete encyclopedic knowledge about the Fungal Infection: its nature, properties, life cycle, and contents. 0adc6d40-12b0-5669-b8d3-68f8115780ad.description: When exploring new places in person, you have a chance to find unique materials and resources from the Mythic Metals and Gobber mods for Minecraft - even if it doesn't make much sense for them to be there, and even though they definitely weren't there before you explored the area. This effect only triggers in locations you explore personally, and its strength is inversely proportional to your prior knowledge of the area: the more you already know about a location before setting foot there, the less effective this perk becomes. If you have no other mod perks, you may instead choose to have this perk select a random source mod with material or resource content for you from all Minecraft mods list.

d60d1528-c886-5c4a-acd6-9edaa9c615ee.description: You possess basic skills and practical knowledge across a wide variety of disciplines, including farming, animal husbandry, riding, mining, cartography, fishing, and more. Essentially, anything mundane an average player can accomplish in the vamilla Minecraft game, you can now attempt at a basic, functional level. Chopping down a tree, constructing a simple shelter, or hunting wild game for food are well within your reach. While you are capable enough to get by and handle everyday tasks, you remain an amateur in all these fields - competent, but unrefined. Still, having a broad foundation is far better than starting with nothing at all.

56a3c0b3-59d8-51cd-91ff-5f925b6d9491.name: Jewelry and Baubles
56a3c0b3-59d8-51cd-91ff-5f925b6d9491.description: You become a master jeweler of exceptional skill, gifted with the special ability to create a wide variety of magical jewelry and baubles and to utilize them effectively. This perk encompasses the full content from several mods, including Iron's Gems 'n Jewelry, Jewelry (RPG Series), and Magical Jewelry, along with all their respective addons and expansions. You understand the intricate art of gemcutting, precious metalworking, and enchanting jewelry with potent magical effects.

8f3001cc-b791-5606-9b2d-1acb58868d7e.name: Just Enough Items
8f3001cc-b791-5606-9b2d-1acb58868d7e.description: This thinker power grants you the ability to obtain a mental blueprint for crafting any object you are holding in your hands or currently examining. It provides the simplest, most straightforward version of the recipe first, drawing upon your existing perks and knowledge to generate a feasible method. More complex items require additional time to analyze, and in some cases, the power may fail to provide a blueprint if the object cannot be reasonably recreated with the abilities you currently possess. When successfully crafting an item using one of these blueprints, you may occasionally discover new variations or improved versions of the original design - particularly if you are lucky or if the power learns something significant during the process. This perk is exceptionally useful for reverse engineering technology, magic items, or any intriguing object you happen to come across.

38259970-fda6-5b13-8733-25df338f7114.name: Large Ore Deposits
38259970-fda6-5b13-8733-25df338f7114.description: This perk grants you the power to perform a special ritual that creates a substantial ore deposit beneath your current location. By sacrificing a targeted material as a "seed," along with several other components determined by the primary material, you can force the generation of a large underground vein containing raw ore inspired by the sacrificed seed. The more esoteric, rare, or unique the material you wish to duplicate, the more elaborate, complex, and costly the ritual becomes - requiring rarer catalysts, more precise conditions, or additional steps. The ritual can only be performed once every 24 hours, and it carries a risk of failure if you are underprepared, interrupt the procedure, or make a mistake in its execution.

15311bcb-58e5-5eed-9839-dde438ff0d11.description: You know how to construct a loom and possess the professional skill to use it in creating various cloth-based items. This perk provides a complete mental compendium of every fabric-based item from Terraria (including silk, banners, clothing, and accessories) allowing you to craft them from raw materials. Additionally, this perk includes the knowledge, skills, and a small degree of magical ability required to craft the full range of dyes and paints from Terraria. You can produce vibrant colors from local flora, fauna, and minerals, and you have the expertise to apply these pigments to your other creations with professional and stylish results.

9cc4f82d-6ea1-59bc-8f7b-04ca16d24d4a.name: Mekanism
9cc4f82d-6ea1-59bc-8f7b-04ca16d24d4a.description: You possess access to blueprints for all craftable items, a comprehensive theoretical foundation, and the basic skills necessary to construct machines and devices from the Mekanism mod, along with its various popular add-ons. This perk encompasses the full scope of Mekanism's core modules: Additions (miscellaneous gadgets and decoration), Generators (power production systems), and Tools (equipment and armor). However, as you venture further from the main theme of the base mod and deeper into add-on content, your understanding becomes progressively more limited and less straightforward - the further an add-on strays from Mekanism's core focus, the more difficult and unreliable your ability to comprehend and create its content becomes.

02b256ef-7398-56b3-8acd-e29b0653299f.description: You gain the ability to create a mystical portal that leads to a personal mining dimension, inspired by Aroma1997's Dimensional World mod for Minecraft. The contents, resources, and terrain of this dimension are permanently set at the moment of the portal's creation, based entirely on the perks and abilities you possess at that time. Once the dimension is actualized, acquiring new perks after this point will not alter its contents. However, this perk may be purchased multiple times. Subsequent purchases are discounted to 350 CP and allow you to create an additional, separate dimension, each with its own unique contents based on your perk loadout at the time of its creation.

1a6a94d9-5703-504e-9361-89b71a368d29.name: Modded Ores
1a6a94d9-5703-504e-9361-89b71a368d29.description: You gain the ability to infuse any landscape with Minecraft-style ore generation - once per purchase of this perk. When activated, the effect targets a radius of up to one thousand chunks (approximately 1,600 meters) around your current location. Within this area, new ores will generate underground, drawn from a single mod of your choice for which you possess the corresponding perk. The ores spawned by this effect possess all the unique properties, behaviors, and uses inspired by their source mod, allowing you to introduce new resources into worlds that previously lacked them. You may hold this activation indefinitely, waiting until you find the perfect location and perk before committing the effect. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional roll stockpiling another activation for later use. At the moment of casting, you decide which mod's ores will generate. Subsequent purchases after the first are discounted to 350 CP. This perk can be discarded and rerolled for free.

167553d3-d10b-50f9-b22f-cf973854c9b0.description: "A modpack-maker's toolset for creating custom, massive, unique, and complex machines and recipes from scratch." This perk grants you extensive knowledge of modular machine design methodology, along with a supernatural advantage when designing and building modular modifications for any creation you already know how to make. Heavily inspired by the mod of the same name, this ability allows you to construct elaborate, multi-block industrial systems with interchangeable components, tailoring each machine to perform exactly the task you need.

b646e690-763a-5664-8824-f4d4a9011ded.description: This perk grants you the equivalent of one Life Crystal or Life Fruit use, depending on how many times you have already purchased it. Each purchase permanently increases your life energy and enhances your ability to survive damage. This perk may be purchased multiple times - up to 35 times in total. The first 15 purchases function as Life Crystal equivalents, providing a solid foundation of increased vitality. The subsequent 20 purchases function as Life Fruit equivalents, further enhancing your maximum life beyond the initial threshold.

1fa4c400-3cd6-5f08-8e1e-156efe3b83e1.description: This perk grants you the equivalent of one Mana Crystal use, permanently expanding your magical reserves. The first purchase awakens your connection to Terraria-style mana, granting you access to this energy system for the first time. Each subsequent purchase makes your mana reserves a little bit larger. This perk may be purchased multiple times (up to 10 times in total) allowing you to build a substantial well of magical energy to power spells and enchanted items.

a7def2d9-b2a7-521d-b62e-6559098d1c4d.description: You gain the supernatural ability to craft and cultivate magical plants that produce a wide variety of resources, drawing from the Mystical Agriculture mod and its various add-ons. Your mystical crops can yield everything from basic Minecraft materials to resources from other mods, allowing you to grow what would otherwise need to be mined or crafted. You possess a great natural talent for gardening and a keen intuitive understanding of magical flora, enabling you to nurture your crops effectively and expand your agricultural operations with confidence.

54b4e997-49f8-5db5-af48-c8411da7fa54.description: You gain the ability to trigger a single, massive burst of Minecraft-style ore generation in any landscape you choose. Upon activation, ores ranging from coal and iron to redstone and amethyst geodes will spawn throughout the underground in a radius of one thousand chunks (roughly 1,600 meters) around you. All generated ores possess their unique properties as inspired by their source game. You may hold this perk's activation charge indefinitely, allowing you to wait until you find the perfect location to use it. This perk can be purchased multiple times, stockpiling additional activations for later use. Each purchase after the first is discounted to 200 CP.

404ba0da-1647-5a71-affc-834bbc725e1a.description: You gain a pair of Apple Saplings of random quality from the Stardew Valley game. You can hold off releasing the bag into the world for as long as you like. They work like normal plants if left to grow in the wild. However, if someone or something plays an active role in cultivating and tending to this Apple Tree, it starts to grow abnormally fast (maximum speed of 28 days to fully grow in perfect conditions). It still exhausts the soil just as much as normal plants do. This perk can be purchased multiple times.

1eed7e3b-fcca-5f19-a963-b8c020d569ea.description: "This is a really simple mod, which adds rings that, when equipped in a baubles slot, provide a permanent potion effect. Wearing two of the same ring upgrades that effect to level two." You gain the capability to create and enchant rings that grant continuous potion effects while worn. This crafting method specializes in Minecraft-style potions and works best with vanilla effects - producing stable, reliable rings with predictable results. Wearing two identical rings will upgrade the granted effect to its second level. However, this perk has limitations. Potions from other sources will generally not work with this enchanting method, and the rare few that do prove compatible may cause dangerous failures or unpredictable side effects during the creation process. Additionally, this perk does not grant you any ability or skill to brew potions themselves; it only enables you to embed existing potion effects into rings. You must obtain your potions elsewhere.

With this power, you can collect, store, transfer, and convert EMC, allowing you to duplicate existing items or transmute materials into entirely different substances. You gain a complete understanding of how to construct and operate all devices related to this alchemical system of ProjectE Minecraft mod.

You possess a complete mental compendium of every Redemption item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and redemption-forged properties of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical essence from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

You may hold this effect in storage indefinitely, waiting until you find a suitable location before unleashing it. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional purchase (discounted to 300 CP) stacking another held activation for later use. The first purchase of this perk grants you complete encyclopedic knowledge about the Parasites: their nature, evolution, behavior, and the corrupted contents of the biome. Additionally, you are rendered permanently immune to the infection and any harmful status effects the Parasites might inflict upon you.
