You possess a complete mental compendium of every Spirit mod item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech - unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and spiritual essence of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical properties from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

You have basic theoretical understanding behind working of the portal. Additionally, you gain a remarkable adaptability to high altitudes, allowing you to navigate the sky realms without the disorientation or physical strain that might normally accompany such extreme heights.

35e3444b-ef8f-5e11-98d0-254508b67655.name: The Corruption Spreads
35e3444b-ef8f-5e11-98d0-254508b67655.description: This perk allows you to generate the Corruption biome from Terraria, transforming the area within a few kilometers around you into a purple, blighted wasteland of decay and shadow. Once established, the Corruption will spread slowly outward over time, though the speed and effectiveness of this conversion depend heavily on the nature of the local environment (including native flora and fauna), the resistance of local materials, and geographical features that may hinder or accelerate the transformation. You may hold this effect in storage indefinitely, waiting until you find a suitable location before unleashing it. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional purchase (discounted to 300 CP) stacking another held activation for later use. The first purchase of this perk grants you complete encyclopedic knowledge of the Corruption biome: its properties, creatures, resources, unique phenomena and to take advantage of them. You are also immune to the corrupting effects of the biome, though this does not protect you from its hostile inhabitants.

727332ff-b31a-5dc1-886a-ada2c82d00d2.description: You possess a supernatural talent, theoretical background knowledge, and practical skill in the construction of golems. When not given direct commands, they default to their basic innate programming - such as patrolling, protecting an area, or simply remaining idle until needed.

ce51de5b-4255-5f62-b105-baec10869ee2.name: Vein Mining
ce51de5b-4255-5f62-b105-baec10869ee2.description: This striker power, inspired by various popular mining mods, allows you to harvest extensive quantities of connected or similar material in a single action. By activating this ability while mining a target material/structure - such as starting to chop down a tree - the effect propagates through all connected materials of the same type, rapidly disassembling the entire structure into its base materials. A single swing can fell an entire forest giant or clear a massive ore vein with startling efficiency. However, this convenience comes with significant limitations. You require the appropriate tool for each material type (an axe for wood, a pickaxe for stone, etc.), and the process accelerates tool wear proportionally to the quantity of material harvested. Tools will break faster, and any fuel or energy sources will be consumed at an increased rate. The ability also places additional strain on your body, making you hungrier much faster than normal exertion would. Complex structures built from multiple different material types cannot be reliably broken down with vein mining, and there are hard size limits on how large a single excavation can be. If you possess a personal inventory or pocket dimension, all mined resources will be automatically deposited there; otherwise, they will be neatly piled in stacks near your location.

08471712-8927-5412-9961-9923935c1672.description: This perk allows you to spawn (once) twelve fully stocked chests containing various coins, gems, and metal bars at a targeted location, without causing any damage or disruption to the surrounding area. If insufficient space exists for all twelve chests, fewer will spawn as space allows. The chests contain currency and Terraria-type resources, each retaining their unique properties from the game. The quantity of specific materials scales with their rarity and usefulness: early-game resources appear in greater abundance, while late-game materials are comparatively rarer. You may hold this effect indefinitely, activating it only when you find a suitable location. Stored activations can be stacked without limit, and this perk may be purchased multiple times to accumulate additional uses. If you possess perks for other Terraria mods, the chests will also include materials from those sources, appropriately mixed into the generation.

However, if someone or something plays an active role in cultivating and tending to plants grown from this assortment of seeds, they start to grow abnormally fast. It still exhausts the soil just as much as normal plants do. So it's probably a bad idea to harvest these too often. This perk can be purchased multiple times.

b708f5ce-7418-5675-b001-e11a88f4ab3b.description: Upon purchasing this perk, you may select any single skill from the full list of skills existing in the RimWorld game. This chosen skill is held in reserve, waiting to be applied. You may bestow it upon yourself or upon another person you touch - a process that takes a few minutes of concentration to complete. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each purchase granting another skill level reserve to choose, hold and apply.

467aecea-19d1-59ff-b6a4-b6d22c6e12b9.description: "The best defense is a good offense." You are an expert in the planning and construction of point-defense systems, specializing in Sentinel-class technology. While relatively primitive by interstellar standards, your expertise allows you to maximize their effectiveness against incoming projectiles and missiles. Your knowledge covers both the theoretical and practical aspects of active defense, from optimal placement and targeting algorithms to maintenance and rapid fabrication. A solid foundation upon which to build more advanced countermeasures.

However, this perk grants only the knowledge - it does not provide the laboratory equipment, sophisticated machinery, or practical skills required to perform the genetic manipulation itself. To make use of these blueprints, you must possess the necessary tools and expertise, such as the Biotech perk from a RimWorld or similar gene-engineering capabilities from another setting. Without those, this compendium remains purely theoretical.

Your progression is semi-random, utilizing a "card shuffle" approach where new inspirations arise based on your recent actions. To advance, you must create and use various devices, explore the technologies of others, and remain proactive in your research. Your activities make certain technologies more likely to appear the next time inspiration strikes, allowing you to subtly guide your progression. You may pay an additional 300 CP (half the base price) at any time (either now or the next time you get this perk) to instantly unlock a portion of the tree. You can do this as many times as you wish, provided you have the points to spare. Each purchase grants an immediate leap in knowledge, blueprints, and skills, covering a few of the lowest-tier technologies still ahead of you in this tree (typically one or two). This option does not include Events.

14caf863-ca6d-55f3-99f4-6bea2281c658.description: "An automated surgical device has been added to your arsenal. This machine can precisely remove diseased organs, detach bionic implants you deem unnecessary, or (for those with less ethical inclinations) process prisoners efficiently for bulk extraction of desired body parts." You receive one fully functional Auto Dissector from the mod of the same name. This sophisticated piece of medical machinery handles delicate surgical extraction with robotic precision, minimizing tissue damage and maximizing organ viability. Whether you need to harvest implants from traitors, remove cancerous organs for replacement, or simply process a prison population for valuable components, this machine does the job quickly and cleanly. Along with the unit itself, you receive a thick, detailed technical manual containing comprehensive instructions on how to operate the machine, perform routine maintenance, troubleshoot common issues, and (with sufficient study) construct additional units from scratch. Good luck figuring it out! (The machine's ethical subroutines are optional. Your conscience is your own.)

4eb5d4e0-70dd-512c-a8b4-c94a24cf71aa.description: "The Baol Organism had a unique way of producing tools. Given the species' relative slowness, they would simply grow them out of organic matter in locations that were half orchard, half factory. With the proper genetic adjustments, we could also grow various commodities and tools alongside our regular crops." You possess the knowledge and genetic templates to create Baol-style organic plantations - hybrid facilities that function as both orchard and factory. These living structures can be calibrated to grow tools, commodities, and other useful items directly from organic matter, alongside regular crops. With proper adjustments, your plantations become self-sustaining production centers, silently and steadily yielding whatever you need with minimal oversight.

You possess the knowledge and schematics to construct mining drones equipped with Cybrex-derived memory chips and sensors. The technology is self-contained and adaptable, allowing you to outfit existing drone frameworks or build new ones from scratch.

A solid foundation in personal or ship-scale defense, tempered by the eternal challenge of balancing protection against power consumption.

This knowledge applies across your fleet, from the modest Riddle Escort and the imposing Enigma Battlecruiser (which outclasses standard battleships) to the nigh-impregnable Paradox Titan, a mobile fortress that can shrug off all but the most brutal assaults.

Actually acquiring the resources and putting this information into practice is still up to you.

a5bec5cc-40a3-5908-b877-b387c59897d5.description: Upon purchasing this perk, you may select any single trait from the full list of traits existing in the RimWorld game. This chosen trait is held in reserve, waiting to be applied. You may bestow it upon yourself or upon another person you touch - a process that takes a few minutes of concentration to complete. The effect causes permanent physiological and/or psychological changes to the target, integrating the trait as though it were always part of their nature. Identical traits do not stack, and attempting to apply multiple traits that conflict or interact unpredictably may have unintended consequences. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each purchase granting another trait to hold in reserve for later application. Beware of unintended psychological or physiological effects: tampering with someone's fundamental nature rarely comes without risk.

55db9c40-95f3-5ade-85be-8d3d51edf2c9.description: You possess the unnatural ability to rapidly research and discover technologies from the Propulsion Tree of the Stellaris game. Your progression is semi-random, utilizing a "card shuffle" approach where new inspirations arise based on your recent actions. To advance, you must create and use various devices, explore the technologies of others, and remain proactive in your research. Your activities make certain technologies more likely to appear the next time inspiration strikes, allowing you to subtly guide your progression. You may pay an additional 200 CP (half the base price) at any time (either now or the next time you get this perk) to instantly unlock a portion of the tree. You can do this as many times as you wish, provided you have the points to spare. Each purchase grants an immediate leap in knowledge, blueprints, and skills, covering a few of the lowest-tier technologies still ahead of you in this tree (typically one or two). This option does not include Starter Technologies or Events.

ca9d7e15-a5b3-5fc2-897b-967ba8974afd.name: Redistribute Passion
ca9d7e15-a5b3-5fc2-897b-967ba8974afd.description: This perk grants you three metaphorical charges each day, which you can use to temporarily bestow Passion toward any skill from the list of those existing in the RimWorld game. By investing one charge, you can make yourself (or another) become Interested in that skill; by investing two charges, you can elevate that interest to Burning Passion. This effect does not actually make you more skillful, it does not grant knowledge or ability. Instead, it allows you to take genuine pleasure in performing tasks related to that skill and provides a significant multiplier on experience gain while the passion lasts. All three charges must be used simultaneously when activating this perk. They reset every 24 hours and need to be reapplied if you wish to maintain the effect. You may apply these charges to other people, but if you do, the charges will only return to you after 24 hours have passed. Be mindful of unintended psychological effects - artificially induced passion can sometimes have unexpected consequences on a person's psyche.

02be3bb6-f9cd-59a7-a907-4f73edacf5e5.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of blueprints for items, structures, and even some creatures from the Rimsenal Pack of mods for RimWorld. This includes the full range of faction-specific weapons, armors, apparel, turrets, production facilities, and unique biological entities introduced across the Rimsenal series. Alongside these blueprints, you receive the practical skills needed to effectively utilize and create these items using available materials. Additionally, you gain an incredible natural talent for employing weapons for their intended purpose, allowing you to wield even unfamiliar firearms and armaments with surprising effectiveness. This perk provides only basic background scientific knowledge. Without deeper foundational understanding, your creations will easily default to tinkertech status: reliable in your hands but poorly understood, and difficult for others to replicate or maintain.

22a4a79a-5fe7-5976-830f-9eccad1c43d3.description: Your understanding has transcended conventional science, allowing you to perceive reality as a complex, layered code of physics and spacetime. Only by anchoring your will across dimensions can you make your revisions to the cosmic source code absolute.

Alongside these blueprints, you receive the practical skills needed to effectively utilize and create these items. However, this perk provides no in-depth scientific knowledge. If you do not also possess the Biotech perk from the RimWorld category, your genetic creations will function as tinkertech - reliable in your hands but poorly understood, and nearly impossible for others to replicate or maintain.

1f62b87b-fd8f-5a60-8250-eca1f9601a5c.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of blueprints for every craftable item from the Vanilla Vehicles Expanded series of mods for RimWorld. This includes all vehicle chassis, engines, weapon mounts, utility modules, and specialized transport options across the entire expanded vehicle lineup. Alongside these blueprints, you receive the practical skills needed to effectively construct, maintain, and operate these vehicles. Additionally, you gain a significant degree of natural talent for any vehicle-related mechanical fields (including repair, customization, and performance optimization) allowing you to coax maximum capability from any wheeled or tracked conveyance.

8cb9e1fd-7481-51ef-8d27-8cf8f4501bde.name: Vector Lock Cannon
8cb9e1fd-7481-51ef-8d27-8cf8f4501bde.description: "Biologically enhanced projectiles are fired, countering evasive maneuvers and striking agile targets." Blueprints and the practical skills to grow/create Vector Lock Cannon munitions are now part of your mental library. These biologically enhanced projectiles actively counter evasive maneuvers, making them exceptionally effective against agile targets. A precision tool for hunters who refuse to let their quarry slip away.

34f57d61-6228-5ff2-9fe6-534d29ffe28e.name: Voidcraft Tree
34f57d61-6228-5ff2-9fe6-534d29ffe28e.description: You possess the unnatural ability to rapidly research and discover technologies from the Voidcraft Tree of the Stellaris game. Your progression is semi-random, utilizing a "card shuffle" approach where new inspirations arise based on your recent actions. To advance, you must create and use various devices, explore the technologies of others, and remain proactive in your research. Your activities make certain technologies more likely to appear the next time inspiration strikes, allowing you to subtly guide your progression. You may pay an additional 250 CP (half the base price) at any time (either now or the next time you get this perk) to instantly unlock a portion of the tree. You can do this as many times as you wish, provided you have the points to spare. Each purchase grants an immediate leap in knowledge, blueprints, and skills, covering a few of the lowest-tier technologies still ahead of you in this tree (typically one or two). This option does not include Starter Technologies or Events.

b3b8ef31-f678-5f49-9e52-d42fd3424a41.name: Vultaum Reality Computer
b3b8ef31-f678-5f49-9e52-d42fd3424a41.description: "The reality computers of the Vultaums were unique processing units, dedicated to analyzing existence itself - not quite through physics, but rather by trying to reverse engineer reality's source code and find the glitch that would finally allow the Vultaums to take down the simulation where they believed they lived." You possess the knowledge and schematics to construct a Vultaum Reality Computer - a processing unit designed to analyze the fundamental nature of existence. Rather than studying physical laws, this computer attempts to reverse engineer reality's underlying "code," searching for inconsistencies, glitches, or patterns that might reveal the true nature of your world. While it cannot guarantee answers, it provides unparalleled insight into the metaphysical and the simulated, should such things exist.

a1b3cf02-4cf9-5674-a239-2c073eff585d.description: "Building on the foundations of early bio-engineering, Weavers are crafted to balance agility with increased combat capabilities." Blueprints and the practical skills to grow/create Weaver-class bioships are now part of your mental library. These living vessels refine earlier bio-engineering techniques, striking an elegant balance between agility and combat performance. You also possess average piloting skills sufficient to operate one effectively.

873d8598-cf19-58dc-adb6-a796d737fd6b.name: Xenological Computation
873d8598-cf19-58dc-adb6-a796d737fd6b.description: "After studying multiple pre-FTL civilizations, we have realized there are many alternative ways to calculate the universe. Different societies have developed alternative solutions for their logistics and computing. These alien ways of thinking have introduced entirely new numbers into our mathematics and made it easier to adapt to foreign empires' structures." You have absorbed the computational paradigms of countless alien civilizations. You understand alternative mathematical systems that introduce entirely new numerical concepts, as well as trinary and other non-binary computing architectures. This knowledge allows you to adapt seamlessly to foreign computational and logistical structures, whether for code-breaking, integration, or cultural understanding.

27301868-8c92-531a-8388-e9748c4c2094.name: Yuht Astronomical Interferometer
27301868-8c92-531a-8388-e9748c4c2094.description: "The Yuht were a paradoxical society, obsessed with the idea of finding other sentient species, yet refusing to accept that they were not alone. They were so focused on disproving any claim of alien life, that their bias found a way into their technology. However, with the proper modifications and calibrations, we could certainly fix their powerful detection arrays." You possess the knowledge and schematics to construct and calibrate Yuht astronomical interferometers - powerful detection arrays originally designed to disprove the existence of alien life. With your modifications, these instruments shed their built-in bias and become exceptional tools for deep-space observation. They excel at detecting celestial phenomena, distant objects, and potential signs of other life, providing clarity and range far beyond conventional sensors.

c6524d85-cdb4-504b-887b-036f6e3e74bf.description: "Zro is a fascinating element, prone to chaotic bursts of energy. We believe that with the right artifacts, we could use it to fuel spatial storms over entire solar systems." You possess the knowledge and artifacts needed to harness the volatile element Zro, allowing you to generate and control massive spatial storms.These chaotic energy storms can be deployed across entire solar systems, disrupting sensors, damaging unshielded vessels, and reshaping local space to your advantage. With practice and sufficient Zro, you can learn to direct these storms with increasing precision, turning raw chaos into a strategic tool.
